Subject: Luminara trial: MAP + acceptance tests (next steps)

Hi Sophie / Raj —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a companion acceptance-test checklist for the 30-day evaluation. The goal of this thread is to lock the success criteria, decide on the minimal exit gates, and confirm owners / dates so we can align the pilot sprint calendar.

Top-level asks for you this week:
- Review the MAP worksheet (tab: timeline & owners) and confirm any changes to owners or dates.
- Scan the acceptance_tests.md and mark any tests that are non-starters for you (we've highlighted data/security items as optional for now).
- Confirm preferred cutover demo date (we suggested Feb 25).


Acceptance tests (summary):
1) Latency SLO: 95th percentile generation latency <= 350ms for 512-token requests (sample workload attached).
2) Accuracy pass-rate: domain-specific recall >= 88% on the 200-case reference set (see acceptance_tests.md).
3) Data controls: KV caching disabled for PHI requests or routed to private pool — required for any PHI baseline.
4) Stability: no more than 2 transient errors per 10k requests across the trial.

Exit gates (what must be green to move to a paid pilot):
- Security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence) acknowledged by your security team.
- Acceptance test pass-rate met on the reference set with no critical failures.
- Ops readiness: integration checklist completed and one successful end-to-end run.

Attachments: Luminara_MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline & owners), acceptance_tests.md (detailed test vectors), SLA_Draft_30days.pdf (draft SLA we can negotiate).

I'll capture your feedback into MAP v1.1 and push back to the hubspot deal link after we align.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Thanks Alex — quick notes inline.

On Tue, 03 Feb 2026 at 09:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com> wrote:
> Top-level asks for you this week:
> - Review the MAP worksheet...

A few clarifications from our side:
- Owners: Please move the "Integration lead" from me to Raj — I will stay as business SME but Raj will handle technical sign-off.
- Latency SLO: 350ms 95th is tight for our baseline (our existing infra averages 320ms on short prompts, but >512 tokens we typically see 600–800ms). Can we add a staged acceptance: first pass should meet 95th <= 600ms for 1024-token requests; target to optimize to 350ms for the final report?
- Data controls: we require KV caching disabled for any customer-identifiable requests — that is a hard requirement.

Also: procurement asked whether we can get a 15-day extension to the evaluation once we hit the acceptance tests if there are integration edge-cases. They want the option to sign a short addendum to finalize production cutover.

I'll go through acceptance_tests.md and mark the items tonight.

Best,
Sophie
Director of Product, Luminara Health

Hi Sophie / Raj — looping in procurement thread response and SLA note.

On the evaluation extension: we can offer a single 15-day extension tied to one of two triggers: (A) acceptance tests pass except for non-blocking integration items documented in the "edge-cases" section, or (B) a signed statement from Luminara confirming intent to close to a paid pilot and an associated PO (we'll accept a draft PO for the purpose of hold).

Attached is SLA_Draft_30days.pdf — it includes an option section (4.3) that describes evaluation extensions and credit structure. If procurement prefers, we can convert to an addendum with the specific extension language.

Also to Alex / Camila: action items for us — 1) update MAP owners per Sophie's note (move Integration lead to Raj), 2) relax the initial latency gate to the staged approach (600ms -> target 350ms), 3) mark KV caching as disabled for PHI flows. I'll update and circulate MAP v1.1 once Alex confirms.

Cheers,

Thanks Ben — procurement confirms they will accept the addendum approach (single 15-day extension subject to trigger A). Raj reviewed the owners and we are green to move Integration owner to him.

I've annotated acceptance_tests.md and uploaded comments to the Drive link (see related_links). A couple of notes from the annotated file:
- Test 2 (domain recall) — we flagged 12 cases we think are ambiguous and asked for a human-review fallback before fail classification. Could we add a "human-in-the-loop" soft-fail path that doesn't block the exit gate but is tracked as an action?
- Test 4 (stability) — please include a definition of "transient error" for the record (we suggest 5xx responses that self-recover within 3s and do not affect KV state).

Assuming Alex pushes MAP v1.1 by Monday, Raj & I will validate and return signed acceptance (or a marked list) by Feb 15. If we hit blockers on integration, we will request the 15-day extension per the addendum.
